# CognitiveTaskonomy

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A structured taxonomy of cognitive tasks based on their underlying neural representations, used to define task relations and hierarchies. Serves as a foundational map for designing topology-centric computing systems that can dynamically allocate resources based on task similarity.
